verdict.rationale: Mistral's own Agents API takes natural-language instructions and carries out tasks with built-in tools (code interpreter, web search, image generation, document library) and handoffs between agents. That shows natural-language commands can drive actions. But nothing in the evidence shows the platform itself (workspace, usage, model or batch management) can be operated through natural language rather than the API, SDK or dashboard. missing for 10: evidence that platform and admin operations accept natural-language commands, a documented natural-language control surface for the product itself, and hands-on corroboration of natural-language task execution.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: AI agents autonomously execute tasks using LLMs, with tools, state persistence, and multi-agent collaboration via the Agents API
